trials.claim: Lifetime access to Support Board on base plan
trials.claimQuote:
- Lifetime access to Support Board
- You must redeem your code(s) within 60 days of purchase
trials.reasoning: The vendor states a lifetime license with lifetime updates, and a buyer confirms no monthly fees. The termination clause only applies for breaching the terms and the single suspension report does not outweigh that direct support.

exhibits.quote: Support Board, in its sole discretion, has the right to suspend or terminate your account if you breach these Terms of Service.
exhibits.argument: Lifetime access can be suspended or terminated for breach, so it is not unconditional.

exhibits.quote: Now? They’ve suspended my account for leaving an honest review. 🚩🚩🚩
exhibits.argument: A buyer reports account suspension, showing lifetime access was taken away.

exhibits.quote:
- Lifetime license

- Lifetime updates

- 6 months premium support

- Installed on your server
exhibits.argument: This quote shows the vendor offers a lifetime license with lifetime updates.

exhibits.quote: When I purchased the software, I did a lot of research, and two features caught my attention: white label and no monthly fees.
exhibits.argument: This buyer confirms the purchase has no monthly fees, supporting lifetime access.

trials.claim: 10,000 messages per month on base plan
trials.claimQuote:
All future plan updates
- 10,000 messages per month
- Up to 3 agents
trials.reasoning: The vendor pricing directly matches 10,000 messages a month on the plan. Reports of credits running out quickly concern how fast credits are used, not that the stated monthly quota is different.

exhibits.quote: I found that all my credits were depleted within just a few days of testing.
exhibits.argument: Credits deplete in days, undermining that 10,000 messages per month is sufficient usable allowance.

exhibits.quote: it tells me I have run out of credits, which are required to sync.
exhibits.argument: Extra credits are required for sync, so messages allowance alone does not cover usage.

exhibits.quote: 10000 messages a month | 3 agents | 1.500.000 characters to train the chatbot
exhibits.argument: This quote matches the base plan quota of 10,000 messages per month.

trials.claim: Up to 3 agents on base plan
trials.claimQuote:
10,000 messages per month
- Up to 3 agents
- Up to 1,500,000 characters to train the chatbot
trials.reasoning: The vendor pricing directly lists 3 agents alongside the 10,000-message quota, matching the claim, with no exhibit contradicting it.

exhibits.quote: 10000 messages a month | 3 agents | 1.500.000 characters to train the chatbot
exhibits.argument: This quote matches the base plan limit of 3 agents.

trials.claim: All future plan updates included on base plan
trials.claimQuote:
All future plan updates
- 10,000 messages per month
- Up to 3 agents
trials.reasoning: The terms limit apps purchased outside CodeCanyon to 1 year of free updates and 6 months of support. As binding terms, that materially limits the promise of all future plan updates despite marketing about lifetime updates.

exhibits.quote: The Support Board Apps purchased outside of CodeCanyon include 1 year of free updates and 6 months of support.
exhibits.argument: Updates are limited to 1 year and support to 6 months, contradicting all future updates included.

exhibits.quote: There has been 0 improvement in performance over this year+ of time.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports no improvement over a year, undermining promise of ongoing future updates.

exhibits.quote: The supported apps are included for free and come with lifetime updates.
exhibits.argument: This quote shows the vendor promises lifetime updates.

exhibits.quote: Another point is the regular updates, a crucial aspect of purchasing software.
exhibits.argument: This buyer confirms receiving regular updates after purchase.

trials.claimQuote:
OpenAI and third-party service fees not included
## Refund
60-day money-back guarantee
trials.reasoning: The terms say a full refund is eligible only if strict conditions are verified and that fees are non-cancelable and non-refundable. That directly conflicts with an unconditional 60-day money-back guarantee, and no defense exhibit supports it.

exhibits.quote: You will be eligible for a full refund only if all of the following conditions are verified:
exhibits.argument: The 60-day guarantee is limited to only if strict conditions are verified.

exhibits.quote: Payment obligations are non-cancelable and the Support Board Fees, taxes, purchases, once paid, are non-refundable to the greatest extent permitted
exhibits.argument: Fees are stated as non-cancelable and non-refundable, contradicting an unconditional money-back guarantee.

trials.claim: All supported apps are included plus White Label
trials.claimQuote:
All supported apps are included
- White Label
- OpenAI and third-party service fees not included
trials.reasoning: The vendor states apps are not included and must be purchased separately, and sells the messaging apps as a separate discounted pack. That outweighs the single statement that apps are included for free and the review that only shows whitelabel use.

exhibits.quote: Apps are not included and must be purchased separately from the apps area.
exhibits.argument: Vendor states apps are not included and must be purchased separately.

exhibits.quote: By purchasing this pack you will get the following apps with a 65% discount: Messenger, WhatsApp, Telegram, Viber, Twitter, WeChat, Zalo, LINE.
exhibits.argument: Messaging apps require separate purchase even with discount, contradicting all apps included.

exhibits.quote:
- Apps are included for free

- Premium support

- Scalable - grow with your business
exhibits.argument: This quote shows the vendor states apps are included for free.

exhibits.quote: In my case, we do a whitelabel of GHL and this software is definitely more than enough to support our clients.
exhibits.argument: This buyer confirms using the software for whitelabel client support.
